wellnessLessons.title: Building Emotional Resilience in the Face of Academic Setbacks
wellnessLessons.description: Understanding how to treat low grades or mistakes as data rather than defining personal worth.
wellnessLessons.content: In Agahozo-Shalom, our student creed says: Learn, Adapt, and Lead. Growth mindset means our brain creates new neural pathways every time we analyze an error. When you receive a challenging score: 1) Acknowledge disappointment without judgment. 2) Schedule 10 minutes to walk through specific questions with your teacher. 3) Frame the lesson: What one concept did I learn today that I didn't know yesterday?

wellnessLessons.title: Sleep Hygiene, Restorative Rest & Academic Performance
wellnessLessons.description: Why 7 to 8 hours of quality sleep directly impacts memory consolidation and emotional regulation.
wellnessLessons.content: During deep sleep (REM and slow-wave), our hippocampus replays study notes and transfers them to long-term memory. Cutting sleep to cram notes actually degrades cognitive processing speed by up to 40%. Practice turning off electronic devices 30 minutes before dorm lights-out, do 3 minutes of slow 4-7-8 breathing, and keep your sleeping space calm.

wellnessTips.title: Active Recall & Spaced Practice
wellnessTips.summary: Instead of re-reading notes passively, close your book and write down key concepts from memory. Review at 1, 3, and 7-day intervals.
wellnessTips.actionable: Test yourself with 5 flash questions after every evening study prep.

wellnessTips.title: Box Breathing (Navy SEAL Protocol)
wellnessTips.summary: Inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold empty for 4. Repeat for 4 full cycles to slow your heart rate.
wellnessTips.actionable: Practice this anytime your chest feels tight or thoughts start racing.

wellnessTips.title: Empathetic Active Listening in Family Houses
wellnessTips.summary: When a village brother or sister shares a struggle, resist the urge to immediately solve it. First validate their emotions.
wellnessTips.actionable: Say: "That sounds genuinely heavy. Thank you for trusting me with it. I am here with you."

wellnessTips.title: Living in ASYV Village Harmony
wellnessTips.summary: Our village is built on dignity, mutual respect, and community solidarity. Small acts of cleanliness and respect lift everyone.
wellnessTips.actionable: Greet one staff worker or junior student warmly each morning.
